note: Project heuristics for prompt compilation, not vendor parameters.

C0.label: strict_minimum_completion
prompt_translation: Complete only the minimum missing structure required for a coherent full body.
Do not enlarge the silhouette or add new decorative motifs, material families, armor systems, colors, or signature accessories.

C1.label: conservative_structural_completion
prompt_translation: Extend unseen regions conservatively using the already visible design language.
Do not introduce new primary motifs or increase ornament density; keep silhouette expansion minimal and functional.

C2.label: creative_but_family_preserving_completion
prompt_translation: Allow limited creative extension while preserving the original design family and hierarchy.
New details must remain secondary and cannot compete with the existing primary design language.

C3.label: authorized_redesign
prompt_translation: Redesign is authorized, but explicitly preserve any user-locked identity or canon constraints.
